Hi , i was just practicing some questions and when i tried this question i felt I solved it right but test cases fails . Can anyone help with what mistake I am making here ?

q. # OPPE Practice 3

## Problem Statement

Write a function `parent-of-parent` in the script `script.sh` to return the parent of parent directory of the file/directory that is passed as an argument.

Note: Parent of `/` is `/`.

my script.sh >

#!/bin/bash

parent-of-parent() {

path=$(dirname **"$1"**)

parent=$(dirname **"$path"**)

**echo** **"$parent"**

}

parent-of-parent “$1”

posts.name: Parthiv Kumar
posts.cooked:
i did a check of what input out i was getting to the function,

-> /opt/se2001/oppe-practice-3/public/test_case_1

1c1,4

< a/b

---

> input:

> par:.

> input:a/b/c/d

> par:a/b

-> /opt/se2001/oppe-practice-3/public/test_case_2

1c1,4

< /tmp/1

---

> input:

> par:.

> input:/tmp/1/2/3

> par:/tmp/1

Public Testcases Passed: 0/2

for some reason there is a blank input before the actual input is sent , can anyone explain why??

posts.name: Amitava Bhattacherjee
posts.cooked:
Try this,

parent-of-parent(){

 file_dir=$1
 if [ $file_dir == "/" ]
 then
     echo "/"
 else
     echo $(dirname $(dirname $file_dir))
 fi

}

posts.name: S.Vignesh
posts.cooked:
You don’t have to invoke the function within the script file. Remove that line and see if it works.
The function will automatically be invoked by synchro eval against the test cases.
